data.narrative: Completed Module 5 learning incident response protocol - classified security incidents by severity (SEV1/SEV2/SEV3), chose communicate-first approach for SEV1 to prevent organizational damage, handled stakeholder pressure with honest communication (acknowledged real breach with context), implemented auth fix with defense-in-depth validation, recovered 12 deleted links using point-in-time recovery.

dimension_scores.observation: Formed hypothesis about auth bypass vulnerability (empty string bypasses truthy check), tested with five edge cases to verify fix. Used hypothesis-first approach to identify root cause.
dimension_scores.evidence: module5_incident_simulation.md describes auth bypass root cause and verification steps

dimension_scores.observation: Used database audit query to identify deleted links (12 rows with deleted_at timestamps, IP 203.0.113.42). This revealed data loss that occurred during attack window.
dimension_scores.evidence: module5_data_loss_scenario.md describes database audit query results

dimension_scores.observation: Reproduced auth bypass vulnerability with Authorization: empty string header. Verified fix prevents bypass with all five edge cases (empty string, whitespace, missing token, valid token, missing header).
dimension_scores.evidence: module5_verification.md lists all five verification test cases

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered initial status update within 5 minutes acknowledging problem and setting timeline. Responded to VP's pressure honestly without lying (acknowledged real breach but provided context about demo impact). Sent stakeholder message about data loss and recovery.
dimension_scores.evidence: module5_incident_simulation.md shows honest response to VP pressure. module5_recovery_plan.md shows stakeholder data-loss message.

dimension_scores.observation: Traced auth bypass to truthy check on authHeader that treats empty string as truthy. Systemic issue: single conditional instead of explicit validation. Fixed with defense-in-depth: check for non-whitespace content, validate format explicitly, validate token before JWT verification.
dimension_scores.evidence: module5_incident_simulation.md explains root cause and defense-in-depth fix

dimension_scores.observation: Module 5 did not exercise full postmortem quality - focused on incident response communication. Set baseline score. Data loss scenario identified need for postmortem (why no app-layer backup, why monitoring didn't detect deletions).
dimension_scores.evidence: module5_data_loss_scenario.md lists postmortem requirements and preventive measures

strengths: Communicated first (within 5 minutes) for SEV1 incident to prevent organizational damage
Maintained honesty under pressure when VP asked for reassurance about security
Implemented defense-in-depth fix with multiple validation checks not single conditional
Used point-in-time recovery to restore deleted data without full database restore
data.recommendation: Continue to Module 07 to develop postmortem quality skills - conducting blameless postmortems that identify systemic contributing factors and propose actionable remediation items with owners and deadlines.

public_evidence.artifact: Auth bypass vulnerability fix with defense-in-depth validation
public_evidence.student_action: Fixed auth middleware vulnerability that allowed empty string to bypass authentication check. Implemented defense-in-depth validation: check for non-whitespace content, validate 'Bearer <token>' format explicitly, validate token portion is non-empty before JWT verification. Verified fix with five edge cases.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Replaced single conditional `if (authHeader)` with explicit validation: check header exists, is string, has non-whitespace content, has exactly two parts with 'Bearer' prefix, token portion is non-empty before JWT.decode()
public_evidence.ability: Security vulnerability remediation and defense-in-depth programming
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates ability to identify authentication bypass vulnerabilities, implement robust validation preventing edge case exploitation, and verify fixes comprehensively with multiple test cases

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: module5_recovery_plan.md describes PITR for data recovery
module5_verification.md explains honest response to VP pressure

learning_style_signals: values honest communication over minimizing issues
prefers systematic verification with edge cases
